definitions.full: H3152. Yizliy 'ah יִזְלִיאָה proper name, masculine a Benjamite 1Chr 8:18 ( ᵐ5 Ζαρεια , A Εζλια , ᵐ5 L Ἰεζελια ). זלג (Arabic glide, slip ; of arrow, skim, slide along ; a kind of latch, sliding bolt ; Aramaic זְלַג is pour forth (tears), flow down ).
definitions.rootNote: perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out;
